required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Official standard application for federal assistance submitted via Grants.gov.

required_documents.name: Project Narrative / Work Plan
required_documents.details: Comprehensive description of proposed activities, statement of need, measurable goals, and implementation timeline.

required_documents.name: Budget Narrative and SF-424A/C Budget Form
required_documents.details: Standard federal budget form and line-item justification explaining all requested costs.

required_documents.name: Project Abstract Summary
required_documents.details: Brief public summary describing project objectives, activities, deliverables, and intended community beneficiaries.

required_documents.name: Letters of Support and Partner Commitments
required_documents.details: Letters from community partners, cooperating state/local agencies, or stakeholder organizations.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI and Grants.gov Workspace Registration
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with Unique Entity Identifier and active Grants.gov user credentials.

eligibility.summary: Eligible entities include higher education institutions, nonprofits, for-profit entities, or state/local government bodies as specified in the notice.

cost_share.details: Cost sharing requirements not explicitly mandated in notice.

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided each application is scientifically and programmatically distinct.
important_notes: Applications must be submitted electronically through the designated portal prior to the deadline: 2026-12-30.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Ensure all project narrative and attachment page limits are strictly respected to avoid administrative rejection without review.
